tools.name: domain-lookup
tools.title: Domain Technologies
tools.description: Returns the live web technologies used on the root domain name.

tools.name: domain-api
tools.title: Domain API
tools.description: Domain API JSON lookup for technology and metadata by domain.

tools.name: domain-api-json
tools.description: Raw Domain API JSON lookup for technology and metadata by domain.

tools.name: change-api
tools.description: Change API JSON lookup for technology additions and removals by domain. Supports one or more comma-separated domains and optional natural language SINCE values such as 'last month'.

lookup.description: Domain name, or comma-separated domain names, to check for technology changes

since.description: Optional natural language date range such as 'last month'; defaults to 3 months

tools.name: relationships-api
tools.description: Relationships API JSON lookup for related websites by domain.

tools.name: free-api
tools.description: Free API JSON lookup for category/group counts by domain.

tools.name: company-to-url
tools.description: Company to URL API JSON lookup for domains from a company name.

tools.name: tags-api
tools.description: Tags API JSON lookup for related domains from IP or attributes.

tools.name: recommendations-api
tools.description: Recommendations API JSON lookup for technology recommendations by domain.

tools.name: redirects-api
tools.description: Redirects API JSON lookup for live and historical redirects by domain.

tools.name: keywords-api
tools.description: Keywords API JSON lookup for keyword data by domain.

tools.name: keywords-search-api
tools.description: Keyword Search API — find websites containing a specific keyword. Returns a list of matching domains and a NextOffset value for pagination. Costs API credits per query.

offset.description: Domain name from the previous response's NextOffset for pagination

tools.name: trends-api
tools.description: Trends API JSON lookup for technology trend data.

tools.name: product-api
tools.description: Product API JSON lookup for ecommerce product searches.

tools.name: trust-api
tools.description: Trust API JSON lookup for trust scoring by domain.

tools.name: vat-api
tools.description: VAT API JSON lookup for VAT, GST, CNPJ, ABN, and other publicly displayed company registration numbers associated with websites. Accepts 1–16 comma-separated domains. Uses 1 API credit only for each domain that returns registration data; domains with no results use no credits. Returned identifiers are found on public websites and are not verified or validated by BuiltWith.

lookup.description: One to 16 domain names, separated by commas

tools.name: vat-types-api
tools.description: List every company registration type that the VAT API may return, including its code, friendly name, and description. This public endpoint requires no API key and uses no API credits.

tools.name: whoami-api
tools.description: WhoAmI API JSON lookup for account limits, credit costs, privacy flags, max batch sizes, and endpoint inventory. Uses no API credits. Call this first to make account-aware decisions.

tools.name: usage-api
tools.description: Usage API JSON lookup for current credit balance (used, purchased, remaining). Uses no API credits.

tools.name: mcp-list-api
tools.description: Search and browse remote MCP servers in the BuiltWith MCP registry (v2). Requires a BuiltWith API key supplied as a bearer token. Provide search, category, or both. Returns up to 100 results per page as a JSON array of {Domain, Category, Description, Endpoints: [{Endpoint, AuthRequired, Tools: [{Name, Description}]}], first_detected, last_detected}, and preserves the complete API response including any fields added in the future. Uses no API credits.

search.description: Keyword matched against MCP server domains and descriptions; required when category is omitted

category.description: MCP registry category slug; required when search is omitted

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (default 0; page size is 100)

tools.name: mcp-list-categories
tools.description: List valid BuiltWith MCP registry category slugs, labels, and entry counts (v2). This public endpoint requires no API key and uses no API credits.

tools.name: list-api
tools.description: List API JSON lookup for websites using a primary technology. Requires an active BuiltWith plan. OTHERTECHS are subordinate filters and do not consume additional primary technology report slots.

tech.description: Primary technology name, such as Shopify

otherTechs.description: Optional comma-separated subordinate technology filters; these do not consume additional report slots

tools.name: payment-balance
tools.description: Check an existing account's API-credit balance through the saved-Stripe-method top-up service. This is not x402.

billingKey.description: Separately scoped Agent Billing Key; optional when the MCP request uses a compatible credential

tools.name: payment-config
tools.description: Retrieve saved-Stripe-method account top-up limits, UTC monthly period, purchase increment, and idempotency rules. This is not x402.

billingKey.description: Separately scoped Agent Billing Key; optional when the MCP request uses a compatible credential

tools.name: payment-purchase
tools.description: Charge an existing account's saved Stripe payment method and add account API credits. This is not x402. Requires the separately scoped Agent Billing Key, fixed 2,000-credit increments, and an idempotency key.

credits.description: Number of account API credits to purchase in fixed increments of 2,000

billingKey.description: Separately scoped Agent Billing Key from payments.builtwith.com/agent-payment-api-config

idempotencyKey.description: Unique operation identifier; reuse only when retrying the identical purchase

tools.name: vector-api
tools.description: Search BuiltWith technologies and categories by text query using vector similarity. Returns ranked results with similarity scores (0–1), descriptions, and category info. Useful for discovering what technologies match a concept or description (e.g. 'react framework', 'payment gateway', 'live chat'). Costs 1 API credit per query.

query.description: Text to search for (e.g. 'javascript framework', 'email marketing')

tools.name: ask-api
tools.title: Ask API
tools.description: Ask API lookup for natural language website list queries. OpenAI requests are served as preview results and do not commit full reports.

query.description: The natural language query (e.g. 'Magento websites in Spain')

commit.description: Ignored for OpenAI/ChatGPT requests; preview mode is always used there

nextOffset.description: Pagination offset from the previous response's NextOffset

meta.description: Set to true to include metadata in the results

tools.name: ask-api-json
tools.title: Raw Ask API JSON
tools.description: Raw Ask API JSON lookup for app/internal use. OpenAI requests never send COMMIT=true.

query.description: The natural language query (e.g. 'Magento websites in Spain')

commit.description: Set to true to run a full report returning up to 1000 results

nextOffset.description: Pagination offset from the previous response's NextOffset

meta.description: Set to true to include metadata in the results

tools.name: x402-pricing
tools.description: Show prepaid batch-credit pricing, x402 configuration, and List pass tiers. Optionally quote a credit quantity. Uses no payment.

tools.name: x402-credit-purchase
tools.description: Purchase a batch of at least 2,000 non-expiring BuiltWith API credits with one x402 payment. Returns a reusable secret credit key; provide an existing key to top it up.

payer.description: Base wallet address that will sign the x402 payment

creditKey.description: Reusable prepaid key returned by x402-credit-purchase

tools.name: x402-credit-balance
tools.description: Check purchased, used, pending, and available credits for a reusable prepaid key. Uses no payment and consumes no credits.

creditKey.description: Reusable prepaid key returned by x402-credit-purchase
